question: Which of these joined the United Nations MOST recently?

post.premise: The newest UN member is younger than Instagram
keywords: how many countries in the un

youtube.title: Newest country in the world? Which of these joined the UN most recently 🇺🇳
youtube.description:
One of these three only joined the United Nations in 2002 — and most people would swear it was a founder.
Which one did you assume was the oldest member? Say it before the map lights up.
Subscribe for a map quiz you can argue about every day.

instagram.caption:
Which of these joined the United Nations most recently? 🇺🇳
Switzerland, famous for staying out of everything, only joined in 2002. The newest member is younger than this app.
Which one did you pick — and which one surprised you?

facebook.text:
Which of these joined the United Nations most recently — Switzerland, South Sudan or Montenegro?
One of them waited until 2002 and needed a nationwide vote to do it. Did you know that one?

twitter.text:
Which of these joined the United Nations most recently?
Switzerland only got there in 2002 — by referendum. The newest member is younger than most memes.

threads.text: Which of these joined the United Nations most recently — Switzerland, South Sudan or Montenegro? One of them is a country younger than Instagram, and Switzerland only joined in 2002 after a national vote. Guess before the map lights up.

not_spoilers.2002: Switzerland's own year — a distractor fact used as bait; the answer's numbers (2011, 193) stay out

post.bait: Most people would swear Switzerland was a founder.

intent: A newsroom explainer: brisk, exact dates, one surprise per sentence.

v04.text: South Sudan. It became member number 193 on 14 July 2011, just days after independence.

v05.text: Montenegro joined in June 2006, just a month after its own independence vote.

v06.text: And Switzerland, neutral since 1815, only joined the UN in 2002, after a nationwide referendum.

v07.text: 193 members today, and nobody at all has joined since South Sudan.

v08.text: The youngest flag in the room. Follow us.

research.topic: Which of these joined the United Nations most recently? (South Sudan, 14 July 2011; Montenegro 28 June 2006; Switzerland 10 September 2002)

myths.myth: Switzerland was a founding member of the UN.
myths.reality: Switzerland stayed out on neutrality grounds and joined only on 10 September 2002, after a referendum on 3 March 2002.

landscape.our_gap: UN Day explainers list '193 members' over a flag montage; nobody puts the three late joiners on one moving map with their dates and the newest flag rising out of the country.
